title: Dana I frequent lost connection
symptom: The Dana I pump frequently loses connection with the phone (Cubot pocket). The phone shows no activity, but the pump display still shows connection activity, indicating the disconnect message is not received. This leads to 'pump not available' messages at various times.
cause: The thread initially suggests the disconnect message is sometimes not received by the pump. Later, the user reports that after more than a year, they discovered the issue was likely due to faulty BT hardware on the phone, as an identical phone with identical software maintains the connection without problems.
fix: The user resolved the issue by replacing the phone with an identical model with identical software, which fixed the frequent connection losses. Additionally, a developer suggested testing version 3.2 dev, which had an improvement.
evidence_quote: now after more than a year it looks like there was something wrong with the BT hardware on the phone!!!!! Connections got better over time with updates but still got lost frequently. We bought an identical phone with identical software numbers and now, no problems keeping the connection.
